games.name: [VERGIL👾] RNG SHOWDOWN
games.desc:
Welcome to RNG SHOWDOWN, an exhilarating and unpredictable battleground where every player is granted a unique random power each time they respawn. Whether you receive a power that is incredibly rare and mythical or something hilariously useless, each round promises a unique challenge and excitement.

Step into the chaos as you battle other players, utilizing the luck-driven abilities that you are granted. Collect and discover a diverse array of abilities, upgrade your chances for better powers, and strive to dominate the leaderboards. Every game session in RNG SHOWDOWN is different, challenging your luck and combat skills against others.

Will you draw the all-powerful skill of a deity, or face the amusing embarrassment of an ineffective ability? There's only one way to find out—dive into the ultimate test of luck and power in RNG SHOWDOWN!

games.name: SURVIVE PURSUER (Die of Death)
games.desc:
Survive The Pursuer.

Version: v3.5

You didn’t exactly choose this place. Life just kind of dropped you here, and now you’re stuck in a forest that was never really yours. Something else lives here, and when night falls, it wakes up hungry. It hunts, it kills, and somehow it always knows where to look. So yeah, no pressure. Grab whatever weapon you can find, try not to trip over a root, and maybe don’t breathe too loud. Your only job is to stay alive long enough to take it down first. Think you can survive the pursuer, or are you about to become part of the wildlife?

Can you survive the pursuer?

Please always note that the game is in a very early stage and finding bugs might be undifficult.

This game is more recommended to play in computer

Saucefy10 Made Die of Death.
Inspired by The Rake Remastered by RVVZ.

games.name: Catch a Pet [🐾]
games.desc:
🐾 Welcome to Catch a Pet🥚

Dive into Catch a Pet, the ultimate creature-collecting adventure where exploration and discovery are in your hands. Travel across vibrant islands to find and capture rare pets—each with hundreds of thousands of possible variations. Grow your collection, master your tools, collect the rarest pets!

[How To Catch]
• Hold down to cast your lasso
• When you're ready to lasso, hold down or click to pull the rope tight. Guide the loop along the black path as closely as you can—don’t worry if you slip up a little, just stay on track to make the catch!
• When the progress bar on the bottom is full, you'll reel in your catch!
